note: 2026-11-13「中考试卷练习」（周一至周五按题型分页的训练卷），共 8 页 10 个大题。原卷在 OneDrive 题库、未入库；卷面手写与红笔批改大量重叠（尤其第 1 页选择题页边），故未录作答痕迹。

Have you ever heard of Colour Walk? It is {{1}} new and relaxing way to enjoy a walk around your city. In early 2026, this activity quickly became popular among young people. They call it a "colour treasure hunt".

Here's how it works. Before you go out, choose a colour that you like, such as red, blue or yellow. Then, during your walk, try to find and record everything {{2}} your colour. It could be a painted wall, a flower, a drink package, or even the sky. You don't need a difficult plan. Just go downstairs and start your walk. It is much {{3}} than you think. You can spot {{4}} objects from shops, plants and buildings.

You can do it alone {{5}} with friends. Walking alone gives you a peaceful feeling, while walking with others brings you different ideas about the same street. Many young people say this activity {{6}} make them feel happy and relaxed. "When I focus on finding red things, I forget all my worries," said one Colour Walk lover.

Last weekend, my friend Li Ming and I {{7}} to try Colour Walk. We chose the colour yellow. As we walked down the street, a yellow taxi caught our eyes. Then, we noticed a beautiful sunflower facing the sun. We {{8}} took photos of these yellow objects before going home and shared the photos online. Soon, our photos were liked by many people. Even {{9}} you only spend thirty minutes outside, you will get great fun from this small activity.

If you feel stressed, why not give Colour Walk a try? Just look around! {{10}} beautiful the world is! Enjoy your time!

Chang An is a Chinese animated (动画的) movie. And the movie was named after the ancient name for Xi'an in Shaanxi Province.

The city had been the capital of the Tang dynasty for over 280 years. The movie used a different view to draw people's {{1}} from the start. Through this movie, Tang poems, a(n) {{2}} traditional culture of China, made the world know more about "the universe of Chinese poems".

Many parents took their children to watch the movie at the cinemas so that they could {{3}} these literary masterpieces (文学经典). Besides, the movie offered people a chance to know what happened in the Tang dynasty. It is often seen as a golden {{6}} in Chinese history because of its economic (经济的) and cultural development.

Forty-eight Tang poems were {{7}} in the movie. People could see the panorama (全景) of the most excellent poets of that time as well as their dreams. There is no {{8}} that the movie was a great work showing the excellent Chinese culture to the world.

And it is {{10}} but meaningful for people to feel the poets' minds better through their poems. This is the reason why so many people wanted to watch the movie and loved the movie.
passages.阅读理解 (A):
Twenty-two years after a youth version of the Kunqu Opera masterpiece The Peony Pavilion was first performed in Taipei, a special "campus youth" version was staged in Taiwan for the first time on 15 January, 2026.

This campus version is an abridged (删节) performance of the nine-hour youth version. It came from a project started in 2024 to encourage young people to join in protecting Kunqu.

The project chose 50 students from 29 universities and colleges. The students, with little training in Kunqu, practised for nearly nine months before bringing the campus version of The Peony Pavilion to the stage in Suzhou, the birthplace of Kunqu, in April 2025.

Kunqu Opera is one of the oldest and most beautiful forms of traditional Chinese opera. In 2001, it was added to UNESCO's list of World Intangible Cultural Heritage. As one of its most famous works, The Peony Pavilion was written in 1598 by Tang Xianzu. It tells the story of Du Liniang, a young woman from a wealthy family. Her father was a high-ranking official, and her family lived in a large house with a beautiful garden. She dies for love after dreaming of a romantic encounter with the scholar (书生) Liu Mengmei. She comes back to life when he finds her.

Young people have always been the main audience for the youth version of The Peony Pavilion. Since its first show, it has been performed at more than a dozen universities. "Our goal is to help college students appreciate the beauty of Kunqu, so they can feel closer to traditional Chinese culture," said 88-year-old Pai Hsien-yung, who has served as the art director in this project.

"For more than 20 years, the love for Kunqu among the people of Taiwan has remained unchanged," Pai said in an interview. "I am pleasantly surprised to see that many high school students also enjoy the performance very much."
passages.阅读理解 (B):
There was a man who played the piano in a small bar. There were not too many customers, but because he was a good piano player, some people still came in every night just to hear him play. But one night, a patron told him he didn't want to hear him play but to sing a song.

The man said, "I have never done that before in public. I think I'm better at playing the piano."

But the customer insisted. He told the waiter, "I'm tired of listening to the piano day after day. I want to hear something new and I want that guy to sing."

The waiter shouted across the room, "Hey, buddy! If you want to get paid, sing a song. The patrons are asking you to sing!"

So in order to bring some money home that night, the piano player who had never sung in public did so for the very first time. And nobody had ever heard the song Mona Lisa sung before until that night by Nat King Cole, and it surprised all, including the singer himself!

He had a talent he was sitting on! He may have lived the rest of his life as an unknown piano player in a common bar, but because he had to sing, he went on to become one of the best-known entertainers in America.

You, too, have skills and abilities. You may not feel as if your "talent" is particularly great, but it may be better than you think! And with persistence (坚持), most skills can be improved. Besides, you may as well have no ability at all if you sit on whatever talent you have! The question is not "What useful ability do I have?" but rather "How will I use whatever ability I have?"
passages.阅读填空:
Stand-up comedy is becoming popular among the young in China. One person, man or woman, stands on stage and tells funny stories that happened to him or her. The performers will try their best to make people laugh.

{{1}} An actor usually has a script (剧本) to fall back on and a team of other actors to rely on. Unlike an actor, a stand-up performer is showing himself or herself but not creating characters. {{2}} It usually takes days or even weeks of hard work to make people laugh for a few minutes. That's why stand-up comedy has often been described as one of the hardest acts to complete successfully.

{{3}} It can include a monologue (长篇独白) on funny things that may form a story. It can simply be a series of jokes. It can also be performed almost anywhere—clubs, bars or parties.

Stand-up comedy has come a long way in the West, but it is a new art form in China. A very popular stand-up comedy show in China is Rock & Roast (《脱口秀大会》). {{4}} When the third season came out, it took the internet by storm and became one of the hottest TV shows in China. {{5}} More and more young people have begun watching stand-up comedy, and some even start doing it part-time. They say it's a great way to relax.
passages.回答问题:
The Wandering Earth 2, directed by Guo Fan, came out in January 2023 as the prequel to the first Wandering Earth movie. It is adapted from Liu Cixin's famous science-fiction novel and marks a new high point of Chinese sci-fi film industry.

In the story, scientists discover the Sun will expand into a red giant and swallow the Solar System in hundreds of years. To save human civilization, the United Earth Government carries out the Moving Mountain Project: building 10,000 huge fusion engines to push Earth away to the nearest solar system. However, conflicts break out. Some people support the Digital Life Project, which uploads human minds into computers, while others stick to saving the real planet. A serious crisis happens when the Moon's orbit becomes unstable and crashes toward Earth. Global people send thousands of nuclear bombs to blow up the Moon, risking their lives together.

Two touching lead lines impress audiences deeply. Liu Peiqiang trains to be a space station astronaut, preparing for the long wandering journey. Engineer Tu Hengyu tries to save his dead daughter Yaya by uploading her consciousness into quantum computers, showing the love between father and daughter.

This 173-minute film has more than 3,000 visual effect shots made by Chinese teams. It earned 4.029 billion yuan at the box office and got an 8.3 score on Douban, winning praise worldwide. Different from Western sci-fi that gives up Earth, it carries a warm Chinese belief: people will stick to their home and move forward hand in hand. It tells us unity, responsibility and family love are forever powerful strength in face of great disasters.

You've won tonight's prize—a trip to Paris!" Angela g{{5}} great joy and courage from this unforgettable experience, and she hoped to join more similar activities in the future.

SUP {{2}}(become) more and more popular in the last two years. It is an interesting sport with special {{3}}(feature).
